alliance_structure.um_structure: Cigna Behavioral Health conducts UM for members accessing care outside MA & RI using CBH providers

summary: The Medical and Pharmacy sections are present in the document but contain no content. Behavioral is OAP carve-in, fully insured (guaranteed cost). Tufts Health Plan pays all behavioral claims. This is a Carelink alliance where Tufts is the coordinating party. Cigna Behavioral Health conducts UM for care outside MA & RI depending on member ID prefix rules. CBH has no claims liability. All claims inquiries are directed to Tufts Health Plan at 800.208.9565.
